newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares rise slightly, volume still low.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares rise slightly, volume still low.

text.p: Lithuanian shares rose slightly on Friday but volume remained low as investors wait for the results of shareholders meetings in March, dealers said.
The group A index inched up by 3,389 points to 2,368.14 and central market volume reached a small 740,400 litas.
Birzai Dairy was the most active listing, turning over 180,000 litas. It advanced to 10 litas from 9.40 litas.
Lithuania Gas also edged up, rising to 2.03 litas from 2.00 litas in trade worth 45,230 litas.
The session's setbacks included the Lithuania Sea Shipping Company, which slipped to 6.67 litas from 7.10 litas in trade of over 85,000 litas.
The banking sector remained quiet on the central market, turning over only 9,800 litas.
Over 1.1 million litas worth of Ukio Bank shares, priced at 20 litas, were swapped in a block trade. The volume of block trades on Friday was 1.8 million litas.
Low yields kept investors away from the secondary T-bill market, which recorded no transactions during the session.
